events.text: In flight. Added temporary diagnostic to StudioViewport.tsx: on-screen bd-diag (bottom-left) showing live mountEpoch + each backdrop's slot/version/texKey/pos, plus a [bd-diag] MOUNT/UNMOUNT console.warn. Compiles clean (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ship). Hypothesis: a .ts hot reload RE-MOUNTS StudioViewport → new mountEpoch → rotates every backdrop slot/texture key → host re-bakes image (the reset); .tsx renders in place so epoch holds. Deeper root cause of the ORIGINAL offset bug (which the per-mount nonce works around): BackdropSurface StaticSurface bakes with warmupFrames:0, so on a remount it likely captures before the <Image> decodes → blank/offset bake, marked ready, never re-captured. Proper fix = give BackdropSurface warmupFrames + stable keys, then delete mountEpoch so the image survives every reload like the camera. WAITING on user to edit a .ts vs .tsx file and report whether the on-screen epoch changes, before applying the fix.
